name: better-compose
description: Thunderbird 撰写窗口的所见即所得编辑器。TinyMCE 之外零依赖：校验、单测、打包全用 node 内置模块

scripts.test: node tools/test-markdown.mjs && node tools/test-config.mjs && node tools/test-i18n.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:static && npm run test
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run xpi
scripts.release: bumpp package.json package-lock.json manifest.json compose/markdown.js --git-check -x "npm run check" --no-push
